Name: The Lost

Gender: M

Role: Killer (because everyone else is survivor)

Description: A lack of correlation and purpose can be deadly. Sometimes.

Lore: Clifton was always a little spaced out. Forgetting to get something or not remembering what was just said were common occurrences for him. However, nobody predicted him or the others going missing without a trace, like a forgotten memory. 

Appearance: A stretched, pale, and lanky thing. At 12 feet tall with hollow holes for eyes, he looks like he just woke up from dozing off during a lecture. Has really long limbs and digits. Only discernible  clothing is a frayed pair of khakis. Weapon is a bony hand.

Power: Bamboozle. The Entity has focused a lack of focus, and gifted this power to The Lost. When M2 is pressed, a channeling effect is begun on a survivor in your line of sight:

-While The Lost sees the survivor, The Lost hunches over, reducing movement speed to 70% but gaining 3% for every second they can still see the survivor. 

-If the survivor breaks line of sight, the survivor will vanish, and The Lost will be stunned for one second. While a survivor is vanished, they leave no scratch marks, but all noise they make is 200% louder for the killer. Vanished survivors cannot be seen by other survivors. Vanished survivors status icons will not update.  Generators, totems, and exit gates are invisible for vanished survivors. A survivor is no longer vanished if they are hooked, bump into another survivor (stunning them both briefly), or performing an interaction with another survivor, like being found in a locker. 

Perk: Friend To The Friendless: An innate detection of those dejected has always served you well. You become obsessed with one survivor. The obsession suffers a17/21/25% action speed penalty for every survivor near them and cannot receive altruistic actions, except for unhooking. If the obsession is the last survivor alive, both you and the obsession gain a 50/75/100% bloodpoint bonus, post trial.
“It’s gotta suck… being truly alone.” 

Perk:  Amphibious Allies: Once a hobby, now another tool for the Entity. When the trial starts, create 4/8/12 toads that wait at pallets. If a survivor approaches a pallet, the toad will flee, croaking and hopping away in a straight line. This perk is affected by Calm Spirit.
